title: Operative A, B and C accumulation rules

lines: A: capital base plus a digital premium
Capital-proportional weights plus the specified digital premium; then normalized
Industrial-protection and catch-up rules follow investment
Computed tau does not debit a separately accounted investment budget
B: digital priority and rate-dependent adjustment
Pre-maturity digital allocation = 0.60; component weights total 1.03
Tau enters additional unemployment and consumption-drag rules
Digital maturity >= 0.50 permits stochastic feedback; it does not ensure success
Allocation responds to FDI availability, import preference and resource exports
Technology, foreign equity and assigned external shocks affect the state
Component bounds are applied separately; weights are not globally normalized
Shared qualifications: the fund is recomputed from model surplus
SFC is a residual diagnostic. M uses corrected accumulation and original engine weights.

notes: Source: accumulation.py, mixed_strategy.py, engine.py and sfc/accounting.py.
